parametrized_description: A hospital needs to schedule nurses for the night shift over T days. The demand for nurses varies each day as given by Demand. Each nurse works Period consecutive days followed by (T - Period) days off in a cyclic weekly pattern. Determine the minimum number of nurses to hire to meet the daily demand.

T.description: Total number of days in the scheduling period

Period.description: Number of consecutive days each nurse works

Demand.description: Number of nurses required on each day

Start.description: Number of nurses starting their shift cycle on day t

constraints.description: The number of nurses working on each day must meet the demand. A nurse starting on day s works on days s, s+1, ..., s+Period-1 (mod T).
constraints.formulation: \sum_{s : t \in \{s, s+1, \ldots, s+Period-1\} \mod T} Start_s \geq Demand_t \quad \forall t

code.gurobipy:
for t in range(T):
    model.addConstr(quicksum(Start[s] for s in range(T) if t in [(s + d) % T for d in range(Period)]) >= Demand[t], name=f"Demand_{t}")

constraints.description: Number of nurses starting on each day must be non-negative.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((Start[t] >= 0 for t in range(T)), name="NonNeg")

objective.description: Minimize the total number of nurses hired.

code.gurobipy: model.setObjective(quicksum(Start[t] for t in range(T)), GRB.MINIMIZE)
